disclaimer: This is screening assistance, NOT legal certification. NOT_DETECTED indicates absence in the supplied photo, not definitive noncompliance.

rules.requirement_summary: The FSSAI logo and 14-digit license number of the manufacturer or marketer must be displayed on the label.
rules.on_present_valid: FSSAI 14-digit license number and logo detected and formatted properly.
rules.on_present_invalid: FSSAI license number detected, but does not conform to the standard 14-digit sequence format.
rules.on_not_detected: FSSAI logo or license number not visible in this image. Note: It may be printed on another packaging panel.
rules.on_unclear: FSSAI logo or numerical digits are partially obscured, blurry, or difficult to verify.

rules.requirement_summary: Every package of food shall bear a declaration of vegetarian (green filled circle inside a square) or non-vegetarian (brown filled triangle inside a square) logo.
rules.on_present_valid: Vegetarian or Non-Vegetarian classification symbol detected and identified.
rules.on_present_invalid: Food classification symbol detected, but value could not be resolved to Vegetarian or Non-Vegetarian.
rules.on_not_detected: Veg/Non-Veg logo not detected in this image. Check the front-of-pack or primary display panel.
rules.on_unclear: A symbol resembling the dietary declaration is present, but colors or geometric shapes are indistinct.

rules.requirement_summary: Packaged food must disclose a complete list of ingredients in descending order of their composition weight or volume at the time of manufacture.
rules.on_present_valid: Ingredients list detected and legible on label.
rules.on_present_invalid: Ingredients heading detected but list appears truncated or empty.
rules.on_not_detected: Ingredients list not detected in this photo. Usually located on the back or side panel.
rules.on_unclear: Ingredients list text is visible but partially truncated, curved around packaging, or low resolution.

rules.requirement_summary: Nutritional information per 100g or 100ml or per single consumption pack, including Energy (kcal), Protein (g), Carbohydrate (g), Total Sugars (g), Added Sugars (g), Total Fat (g), Saturated Fat (g), Trans Fat (g), and Sodium (mg).
rules.on_present_valid: Nutritional information panel detected with standard nutrient disclosures.
rules.on_present_invalid: Nutritional table detected, but key mandatory nutrients (e.g. Added Sugars, Saturated/Trans Fat, or Sodium) may be omitted.
rules.on_not_detected: Nutritional information panel not detected in this photo. Typically located on information panel.
rules.on_unclear: Nutritional table is visible but numeric values or units are blurry or unreadable.

rules.requirement_summary: Presence of common allergenic ingredients (e.g., cereals containing gluten, crustaceans, milk, nuts, soy, etc.) must be declared separately, or stated as 'Contains...' / 'May contain...'.
rules.on_present_valid: Allergen declaration or advisory statement explicitly visible.
rules.on_not_detected: No distinct allergen advisory detected in this view. Verify ingredient list or inspect other panels.
rules.on_unclear: Allergen text or disclaimer is partially obscured or indistinct.

rules.requirement_summary: Net quantity by weight, volume, or number shall be declared on the principal display panel.
rules.on_present_valid: Net quantity declaration detected with standard measurement unit.
rules.on_present_invalid: Quantity text detected, but standard metric unit could not be confirmed.
rules.on_not_detected: Net quantity not visible in this image panel. Usually printed on the front display panel.
rules.on_unclear: Weight/volume numeral or unit is faint, stamped unevenly, or blurred.

rules.requirement_summary: Date of manufacture or packaging, and Expiry date or 'Best Before' / 'Use by' date must be declared.
rules.on_present_valid: Date of manufacture and/or expiry / best before detected.
rules.on_present_invalid: Date stamp detected but format or key dates are partially missing.
rules.on_not_detected: Manufacturing or expiry date not visible in this photo. Frequently stamped on packaging seals or crimp edges.
rules.on_unclear: Inkjet or laser date stamp is smudged, faded, or partially cut off.

rules.rule_name: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer / Packer
rules.requirement_summary: The name and complete physical address of the manufacturer, packer, or marketer must be declared.
rules.on_present_valid: Manufacturer/Packer name and address details visible on packaging.
rules.on_present_invalid: Manufacturer name or address appears truncated or lacking physical location.
rules.on_not_detected: Manufacturer/Packer details not visible in this view.
rules.on_unclear: Address text is very small print or difficult to decipher.
